messages:
Rina (docs): Quick catch from today's review: the /responses OpenAPI examples use inconsistent discriminator keys ("kind" vs "variant") and the multipart curl lacks a boundary block. This is causing our new SDK samples to mis-select oneOf branches and break copy/paste for uploads.

Omar (eng-runtime): can you paste the exact example lines? I can patch the YAML if it's just docs.

Rina (docs): lines here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/blob/main/openapi/responses.yaml#L95-L118. Proposed minimal change: normalize examples to include "variant" as the discriminator in each oneOf example. Example for chat branch: { "variant": "chat", "messages": [{"role":"assistant","content":"Ack"}] }

Devon (sdk): Our generator looks for an explicit discriminator property named "variant" (and mapping). If missing it falls back to a union and the sample code becomes ambiguous. Docs change is the right call.

Rina (docs): For file uploads I'll add an explicit boundary and a Node requests+FormData snippet so both curl and SDK examples are consistent. Curl example I plan to add:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/uploads" \
  -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----RedwoodBoundary" \
  --data-binary $'------RedwoodBoundary\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="note.txt"\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\nnotes\r\n------RedwoodBoundary--'
```

Devon (sdk): also add this Node snippet so integrators see canonical usage:
```js
const FormData = require('form-data');
const fs = require('fs');
const f = new FormData();
f.append('file', fs.createReadStream('note.txt'));
await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', body: f, headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${KEY}` } });
```

Rina (docs): I'll open a small PR updating the examples and add a one-line migration note in docs/migration.md explaining examples now include a discriminator to help SDKs. No schema changes.

ci-bot: PR #4920 opened by rina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4920  updates response examples to include "variant", fixes upload curl example, and adds Node FormData snippet. CI: docs-lint OK, code-sample-check OK.

Casey (pm): Confirming this is docs-only and safe to merge?

Omar (eng-runtime): yes docs-only. No runtime or contract change. Merge when CI is green.

Rina (docs): Merged PR #4920 (commit e8a1d9). Deployed to staging docs.redwood-inference.dev. I'll spot-check the generated SDK samples after deploy. Thanks everyone for the fast sync!
